title: All Seven Members Depart Incheon for Las Vegas iHeartRadio Festival, Resolving Suga's Whereabouts
detail: September 17, 2026 — RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook were photographed together departing Incheon International Airport on the afternoon of the 17th, bound for Las Vegas to headline the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena on Sept 18. Suga's presence in the airport photo lineup put to rest days of fan speculation over his whereabouts after he stayed behind in Los Angeles rather than returning to Seoul with the rest of the group following the ARIRANG tour's SoFi Stadium finale (Sept 5-6) — speculation fueled by an ambiguous Sept 12 Instagram Story appearing to show him in Japan. The festival, presented by Capital One, also bills Cardi B, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson, Benson Boone, Snoop Dogg and LE SSERAFIM across its two days (Sept 18-19), with the BTS set streaming live on Disney+ and Hulu.

media.caption: Suga and Jimin depart Incheon International Airport for Las Vegas, Sept 17, 2026.
